definitions.explanation: Insurance that covers damage or loss caused by fire. In Japan, fire insurance policies typically also cover natural disasters such as typhoons and flooding.

examples.english: When moving into a rental apartment, enrollment in fire insurance is often mandatory.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{火災|かさい}→火災：02561_kasai⟧ (fire, conflagration) + ⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧ (insurance). One of the most common types of property insurance in Japan.

USAGE:
In Japan, {火災保険|かさいほけん} is practically required for both homeowners and renters. Most rental contracts require tenants to purchase fire insurance. Despite the name, Japanese fire insurance policies often include coverage for wind damage, water damage, and other perils — though earthquake coverage ({地震保険|じしんほけん}) is a separate add-on.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {火災保険|かさいほけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}する→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧ — to take out fire insurance
- {火災保険|かさいほけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{請求|せいきゅう}→請求：03374_seikyuu⟧ — fire insurance claim
- {火災保険|かさいほけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保険料|ほけんりょう}→保険料：11058_hokenryou⟧ — fire insurance premium
- {火災保険|かさいほけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧ — to review one's fire insurance
